name: WAS AIX fix pack parameters
description: Which environment's configuration to deploy, and which components. The repository decides the rest: inventories/aix/config/<env>.yml for each server, rendered through inventories/aix/templates/imcl/.

spec.question_description: The environment whose configuration is deployed: the file config/<env>.yml of the inventory, as committed. Only PROD is production.

IHSPLG: the IBM HTTP Server instances and their plugins. WAS: WAS ND on a node server. WASDMR: WAS ND on the deployment manager's server. A component the server does not carry in the configuration is reported and skipped.
The server as config/<env>.yml names it (dev-was-01, pp-ihs-01...). Blank: the host's imcl_server in hosts.yml, else its inventory name.

spec.question_name: I confirm this run may touch PRODUCTION
spec.question_description: Must be answered true for Environment PROD. Defaulted to false on purpose: reaching production should never be the result of picking the wrong answer.
